releaseNotes: Adds iOS Question Bank tools for Share, Copy and Read aloud, groups bank controls in Settings, and scopes progress resets to the active bank, system and topic.
Aligns the iOS sidebar with To Me, exposes Exam Goal Planner, removes Smart Review badges, and shows installed/update version details in Settings.
Fixes mixed old/new files after updating from 1.4.10; cleans old caches
Keeps the iOS notification header route and manual App updates control in Settings while matching the current To Me drawer grouping.
Keeps all existing iOS sidebar page handlers, Smart Review navigation safeguards, and local student data.
Keeps the original iOS final two onboarding screens unchanged.
Fixes iOS first-time offline setup: retries the offline manifest request with a longer timeout and avoids blocking downloads on a forced Service Worker update.
Aligns the iOS app with the complete To Me interface, question-bank screens, visual assets, and shared study features.
Replaces the separate iOS offline installer and silent update layer with the To Me verified offline package and seven-day/manual update workflow.
Adds a working Check for updates control in Settings; only changed offline files are downloaded.
Preserves the iOS onboarding screens and existing student progress, notes, bookmarks, settings, and backup data.
